body:
## Objective
Resolve the two remaining M18.3 external-confirmation admission gates without viewing experimental targets, changing the original M17 four-family criterion, or silently accepting mismatched reference geometry.

## Starting evidence
Base on verified PR #44 at 8a07008ba427cb9cd82c84b5508a1326b562afa0, stacked on #42 → #40 → #38. Preserve all 799 historical parent files and all M18.x blocked findings. Existing 384 candidate inputs are structural interface tests, NOT admitted independent observations.

## A: GFP structure-background qualification
1. Search verified, primary-source compatible structures for the exact assay WT sequence/segment (account for author indexing, fluorescent protein constructs and engineered mutations). Require exact deposited polymer/atom mapping, not RCSB search score or protein name.
2. If exact experimental structure unavailable, investigate a pinned structure prediction specifically for the verified assay WT and contrast it *without outcome labels* against 1GFL: side-chain and backbone geometry around L63F/Q79R reference mismatches, 20 eligible contacting positions, residue contact topology, accessible surface, fold alignment, mutation distances and model confidence; distinguish predicted geometry uncertainty from experimental fact.
3. Determine whether the original preregistered eligibility rules allow a predicted exact-WT reference, or whether a transparent prospective amendment would be necessary. Do not retroactively declare the original structural background acceptable. If evidence insufficient, retain BLOCKED.
4. Validate all affected residue features, source provenance, structure selection and graph interfaces on candidate genotypes only, with no phenotype access.

## B: CspA/CI2 GEO item authorization
1. Seek a complete authoritative source-specific license/usage notice for GEO GSE266299 supplementary fitness_raw and sigma_raw, distinguishing download, noncommercial research analysis, redistribution, output/model sharing and commercial rights.
2. Verify whether author deposited Zenodo CC-BY archive contains a source-linked version/transformation of the GEO file. Byte mismatch alone does not exclude a documented derived lineage. Do not inspect phenotype values to establish it; use provenance scripts/columns, row IDs, headers and checksums when sufficient.
3. If documentation remains inconclusive, draft a precise permission/request email to dataset corresponding author or repository maintainer specifying exact GEO filename/columns and intended noncommercial research analysis. Do NOT send without explicit user authorization.
4. Record the definitive authority/permission gap, not an invented prohibition. Preserve source-code MIT separate from upstream data terms.

## C: Admission/confirmation
- Require four fully qualified families under the unchanged original M17 preregistration with all model-matched structural and assay constraints.
- If both gates clear, commit frozen fold/calibration/prediction/checkpoint manifests and exact read permissions BEFORE external outcome access; then run the single planned H1–H5 confirmation with all negative results, family-wise effects and uncertainty limitations.
- If any gate persists, halt unblinding and file precise PASS/PARTIAL/BLOCKED evidence.

## Engineering
Preserve past artifacts and failures; run source/hash audits, 215+ tests, Ruff, CI; open a draft PR with eligibility report and exact reproduction. No new model architectures, test-driven tuning, fake native stability labels or release tag.
title: M18.4: GFP wild-type background and GEO permission resolution
